FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Operations Manager, phone: (555) 123-4567, email: johndoe@locksmithsolutions.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Locksmith Solutions Plus specializes in providing high-quality residential and commercial locksmith services, including lock installation, repair, and key duplication. Our operations are centered around a secure, alarmed facility located in Springfield, IL. We have been in continuous operation for over three years, ensuring stability and experience in our service delivery. Our dedicated team is trained in security and safety protocols to guarantee professional service to our clients. We pride ourselves on adhering to all local licensing and regulatory requirements, with a commitment to integrity and ethical business practices. We do not engage in equipment rental or subcontracting, maintaining full control over all work performed to ensure the highest quality standards. Providing excellent customer service and maintaining transparent operations are at the forefront of our business philosophy.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a theft incident occurred at our Springfield facility. The locks were tampered with, and several tools valued at approximately $1,500 were stolen. We have since enhanced our security measures, including improved alarm systems and surveillance. The incident has been resolved with no ongoing issues.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL RSC Class 1, Grade B, TL-15 Rating
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure fencing around the premises and 24/7 monitored surveillance to enhance overall security measures.
